title: Chapter 307
text:
"It's not a conclusion. It's just my observation and conjecture," Kerlodd said.

"When I received the mission, the government of this planet described the phenomenon from the perspective of a low-level civilization. It's called the 'Inhuman Phenomenon.' They said that this group of Inhumans appeared out of nowhere, and there were more and more of them. They couldn't tell where they came from, and they just blended into the planet's environment. Their behavior was weird, but they had a special connection with each other. They couldn't die, and they had extraordinary learning habits and growth potential."

He talked for a long time about the Six Nations' views on the players, as well as his observations during this period. Han Xiao wanted to know what the higher-leveled civilizations had to say about this.

"The most distinguishing thing is that they can't die and can be revived. Their personality doesn't change." Kerlodd finally revealed the aura of an investigator and said, "There are many reasons for this effect. The simplest one is that this is a group awakening. It's very rare, but there are many examples.

A more complicated one, like the life projection technology, could be an experiment by a higher-level civilization. Or it could be that the planes overlapped and created a rift, and this group of Inhumans is actually a special creature that accidentally descended from another plane. Or perhaps it was some sort of unintentional high-dimensional projection, the migration of distant civilizations, the projection of time, or a new species that mysteriously appeared under certain rules, and so on. There were more than a dozen theories that could cause such a phenomenon. Just I alone knew of more than ten theories.

The most difficult one is the Space Wonder. Personally, I think this phenomenon is the least likely. "

Kerlodd explained, "There's another big characteristic of the Inhumans. The sudden appearance and the increasing number of Inhumans is more likely to be man-made. We need to use special tools to trace back to the source and see if there are signs of other civilizations. However, we need to apply for a rare detection tool from our superiors. If the civilization behind this is too advanced, Godora won't be able to find out. But to be honest, I don't think there's anything on this planet that could catch the attention of an advanced civilization using life projection technology.

"If we exclude man-made factors and replace them with natural factors, the chances of the planes overlapping are not small. The orbit of this planet may have intersected with a huge crack in the plane, which is why the aliens suddenly appeared, and they are endless. This phenomenon will only disappear when this planet leaves the crack. The crack passage is two-way. Has there been any cases of sudden disappearances on this planet?"

Han Xiao suddenly froze. Didn't Hannes and the others suddenly disappear? Could there really be a crack?

No, the players definitely didn't have much to do with the rift, but there was still a possibility of the existence of a plane.

If the world the players lived in was a plane, it was not impossible for them to interact with this world through the game.

Han Xiao let his imagination run wild for a while and asked, "What's the difference between planes? Does it lead to another universe?"

Kerlodd laughed and said, "There are many ways to describe planes, but there are three basic ones. The first is the secondary plane, which is often seen in highly developed magical civilizations. Powerful mages can summon creatures from other planes, and most of these planes are secondary planes. They are born from imagination and mental power. The more reliable way to describe them is that the mages collapse the endless possibilities of their imagination into a definite reality, which is the materialization of their imagination. Secondary planes exist objectively, but they don't physically exist at the same time. It seems contradictory, but it actually involves the difference in their senses, which limits the perception of different creatures and superhumans. Er, I'm not a mage, so I don't know much about it."

"The second type is the dimensional plane, the microscopic plane, and other planes that actually exist. This is more common and also the most commonly accepted scientific theory."

"The last type of plane is when two planets in the same universe that are very far away from each other establish some kind of connection and create a wormhole. Because they have never interacted before, they think that the other party is from another universe, but it is actually a misunderstanding. What you said about leading to another universe is the multiverse theory, which believes that there are countless other universes. I didn't know that you were a supporter of this theory, but we at Godora don't have much research in this field, so I don't know much about it. "

Han Xiao was deep in thought. Listening to their analysis of this world from the perspective of an 'NPC' was a completely new perspective.

Kerlodd continued, "As for high-dimensional projections, this involves the theory of space-time dimensions. For example, when we look at a two-dimensional plane from a three-dimensional perspective, it is like looking at a piece of paper. This piece of paper has a complete environment drawn on it, such as a two-dimensional person and a mountain range. The world in a two-dimensional person's eyes is also three-dimensional. We have to climb over the mountain to reach the destination, but we can reach any point on the piece of paper with our finger and cross the two-dimensional 'obstacle'. The projection of a three-dimensional on a two-dimensional plane is the small area where our finger touches the piece of paper. This is the image that we leave in the eyes of the two-dimensional person.

The contact surface can be changed, so the image of the projection is not fixed. The senses of the high-dimensional person are different. For example, let's put aside the debate of whether time is an independent variable or a dependent variable. Assuming that time is the actual fourth dimension, then in the senses of a high-dimensional being, we could be a being that has countless points of time stacked together, like a very long worm. This is what it means. The Inhumans could be some kind of high-dimensional being that is in contact with our one-dimensional world. In terms of dimensions, you should seek help from a more professional civilization. Godora is weaker in this aspect. "

Han Xiao pursed his lips. The technology in the players' world was not as advanced as this universe, so it did not look like a high-dimensional projection.

"Let's not talk about the new species theory. I don't understand it. The most unexplainable is the Space Wonder. The so-called Space Wonder is a phenomenon that no civilization can explain."

"So it's unknown?" Han Xiao was shocked. "Even the three Universal Civilizations can't explain it?"

"Haha, even the universe has unexplored areas. Of course, there are unknown things. Hmm, maybe those advanced civilizations have an explanation, but they are keeping it a secret. Let me tell you what I know about the universe."

Kerlodd activated his chatterbox attribute and was very excited.

"I've read the Introduction to Cosmology before. There are countless theories to study the universe. They originate from the instincts of intelligent life and are born from 'who am I?', 'where did I come from?', and 'where do I want to go?' They are all curious about the origin of life, the truth of the world, and the meaning of existence. Among them, the curiosity of the world drives intelligent life to explore the existence of the universe, its form, its essence, its origin, its truth, its development, and its doomsday. Different civilizations come up with different theories about the universe.

"Tracing back to the essence is the exploration of matter. The foundation of matter is particles, and there are endless research theories about particles. In conclusion, different cosmological theories say that particles have different shapes and functions. At the extreme, is a particle just a dot? Or is it spherical like a planet? Has many shapes? Or is there uncertainty in the shape? The most common view is that as long as the essence of particles is found, all the wrong theories will be overturned, and only the correct system will be left.

Indeed, there were theories that successfully justified themselves and obtained irrefutable experimental data. However, it was not just one theory, but hundreds of cosmological theories that had all been proven! Among them, there were even some that seemed to contradict each other! It was unbelievable, wasn't it?

All civilizations' understanding of the world is still one-sided. There is a very long wall between them and the truth. So many theories are like small holes in the wall. Looking through these small holes, you can only see a part of the truth. We can't go through this wall. These theories are our perspective of the world. Different perspectives determine different results, and these results are only the tip of the iceberg of the truth.

"This is just like the sensory limitation that I mentioned earlier. The specific image of the world in the eyes of a creature is largely determined by the sensory abilities of that creature. There are countless mysteries hidden in places that our senses can't reach. Senses are not only convenient for creatures to understand the world, but also prevent them from fully understanding the world.

Do you remember the high dimensional projection that I mentioned earlier? Maybe our universe is the interface between the high and low dimensions, and this universe itself is a projection.

There is even a theory that the world is virtual, and the laws of nature are the physics engine that was created. We are the experimental field created by a greater species to carry out the evolution of the universe, following some extremely complicated algorithm. "
